summary: Earth Detective is an interactive data-analysis platform designed to help users investigate and understand environmental changes across our planet using open NASA satellite imagery and Earth observation datasets. Addressing the challenge of making complex scientific data accessible to everyday citizens, our project transforms raw remote-sensing information—such as land temperature, vegetation health, and urban expansion—into easy-to-explore visual insights. By turning environmental monitoring into a "detective" investigation, users can track local climate shifts, identify deforestation or pollution hotspots, and understand the causes behind ecological changes. This project is important because empowering communities with clear, actionable Earth science data fosters environmental awareness, supports local conservation efforts, and encourages data-driven solutions to protect our planet’s future.
details:
What It Does & How It WorksEarth Detective is an interactive web platform that transforms complex NASA satellite imagery and Earth observation datasets into user-friendly visual investigations. Users select a region or environmental topic—such as urban heat islands, deforestation, water quality, or air pollution—and compare historical and current satellite layers to uncover patterns and causes behind environmental shifts.

Benefits & Intended Impact Scientific satellite data is often difficult for students, educators, and everyday citizens to interpret. Earth Detective bridges this gap by presenting clear, guided visual comparisons and plain-language insights. Our intended impact is to empower local communities, students, and decision-makers to monitor ecological changes in their own regions, build environmental literacy, and take data-backed conservation actions.

Creativity & Design Approach Rather than presenting static charts or raw spreadsheets, we gamified environmental analysis into a "detective" workflow. By framing each dataset as an investigation with clues, before-and-after comparisons, and key takeaways, users stay actively engaged while learning real remote-sensing concepts.

Tools, Languages & Resources Used
